question: Does a Steamer + Marcel blend beat both parents on held-out actuals — and what is the honest accuracy table for the projections this demo publishes?

design.paired_sets: fact_stat_lines (curated warehouse), Cycles 21/24 loaders mirrored: hitters PA>=300 in every season used; pitchers IP>=40 in every season used. A player enters a window only with a Marcel projection, a target-season actual, and a prior-season actual.
design.windows: 2025 = training/reference window (where blend weights would have been fit); 2026 = held-out judge window.

forecasters.marcel: shipped method (Cycles 4/11): 5-4-3 weights, shipped league constants, age term with slopes cross-fitted on the other window only
forecasters.steamer: scoreable only where a Steamer projection and the season's outcomes both exist
forecasters.blend: convex Steamer/Marcel combination; weights fit on 2025 only, judged on 2026 only

design.metrics: Pearson r, RMSE, MAE; primary = hitter OBP, pitcher ERA; secondary = SLG, WHIP
design.bar: Adopt the blend as a published 2027 projection set ONLY if its 2026 primary-metric MAE beats BOTH parents for hitters and is no worse than the best parent for pitchers. An unscoreable blend cannot meet the bar.

steamer_status.status: NOT SCOREABLE — no held-out Steamer outcomes exist
evidence: The repo holds Steamer only for 2027 (data/fg_steamer_2027_bat.json + fg_steamer_2027_pit.json, FanGraphs API pull 2026-10-31): a season not yet played, so no outcomes exist to score it against.

FanGraphs API probed 2026-11-02 with season=2026 and season=2025: the season parameter is ignored — the response is the current (2027) set (4,166 rows; 4,164 MLBAM IDs in common with the committed 2027 file, differing only at update-noise level).

steamerprojections.com's pre-season archive lists downloads only through 2024; the Marcel inputs for 2023/2024 targets (2020-2022 player lines) are not committed — fact_stat_lines begins 2023 — so no earlier paired window can be built either. Its historical-weekly-logs page returned no usable content.
steamer_status.agreement_not_accuracy: What exists for Steamer is agreement with Marcel on 2027 (OBP r = 0.889, mean |diff| 0.010, n = 201 — data/fg_benchmark_2027.json), already shown on Figure 18 and labeled there as agreement, not accuracy.

blend.weights_status: NOT FIT — fitting requires Steamer projections for a completed season; none exist (see steamer_status).

verdict: NOT ADOPTED — the blend cannot be scored, so the pre-committed bar cannot be met. Steamer remains the published 2027 projection set and Marcel the in-house spine, unchanged. No optimizer shadow run (adoption-gated).
recommendation: Do not rewire the stack onto a blend now; the first honest test arrives after the 2027 season, when the committed Steamer 2027 set can be scored against 2027 actuals on this same paired design.
dashboard_change: New benchmark panel under Figure 18 (Explorer, Check the Model): the held-out accuracy table for the scoreable forecasters, with Steamer and the blend shown as not scored, with the reason.
